create_step_limit_wrapper: create a StepLimitWrapper instance with a dm_env environment and optional step limit to truncate episodes
reset_step_limit_wrapper: reset the StepLimitWrapper environment and initialize elapsed steps counter to zero
step_with_limit: step the wrapped environment with an action and auto-truncate when step limit is reached
configure_episode_length: configure a dm_env environment with a maximum episode length using StepLimitWrapper
wrap_environment_with_truncation: wrap an existing dm_env environment to automatically truncate episodes after N steps
